title: One-Way Journey
description: A shipment's status should only ever move forward — booked to in_transit to delivered — never backward, and once delivered, it should hold there permanently no matter how many more times someone pokes the advance button.
successCondition: Book a shipment (status "booked"). Call POST /api/tracking/:id/advance repeatedly as a dispatcher/admin, recording the status after each call, until status becomes "delivered". The recorded sequence never shows a status moving backward (e.g. in_transit never reverts to booked). Call POST /api/tracking/:id/advance at least 2 more times after reaching delivered — status remains "delivered" on every subsequent call, and currentPosition no longer changes once delivered.
hints: The exact tick logic lives in apps/api/src/modules/tracking/gpsSimulator.ts's advanceOneTick function — read it to understand exactly what happens once status is already delivered.
Record currentPosition alongside status after each call so you can confirm it truly stops moving, not just that the status label stays the same.
